headline_claims.claim: Record-entry selection can alter an ecological estimand before downstream classification, and the selected event table alone cannot identify omitted-support biology.

headline_claims.claim: Entry provenance can support partial recovery, but correction has an observation-context transport domain and can fail under broader shift.
